subject: Any examples of using ggplot with the new clickId option of plotOutput?

messages.author: 889de486273d901d
messages.subject: Any examples of using ggplot with the new clickId option of plotOutput?
parts:
I'd like my shiny graphs to be at least a little but interactive, but I would also like to graphs to look halfway decent.
If I use ggplot, the graphs look great but the coordinates returned by the click event are really useless.
For graphs made with plot, the click coordinates are fine but it would take a lot more work to make it look good.

Are there any working examples of using plotOutput(clickId) with a plot made with ggplot2?

messages.subject: Re: Any examples of using ggplot with the new clickId option of plotOutput?
parts: Sorry, but ggplot2 doesn't work with this feature--and neither does it work for locator(). I think this is a general problem that we'll have with anything that is based on grid graphics.
